_comment: alpha_reset.py settings, matched by profile and character tag, never by name. playerCharacters: characters on staff profiles that are their owners' own player characters and play in the alpha. notStaff: player accounts that had admin rights during testing (so the audit log shows GM actions from them) but are not staff. An entry without a tag covers the whole account; with a tag, only that character plays and the account's other characters stay staff-only as test characters. Everyone is reset like everyone else and every staff grant, theirs included, is taken back (Nate, 2026-09-30).
